notes: Read all 108 numbered source lines before editing. Coverage: the file JSDoc describing the icon/label/summary/View-link row and status-driven dot (L1-7); imports of ReactNode, react-router-dom Link, lucide-react ChevronRight, @/lib/cn, and the HeroStatus type from ./StatusHero (L9-13); the DOT_FOR_STATUS bg-*-400 map for healthy/degraded/unhealthy/unknown/maintenance (L15-21); the TEXT_FOR_STATUS text-*-400 map (L23-29); the full HealthRowProps interface incl. JSDoc on status/icon/label/summary/to/external/onClick (L31-43); the destructured signature with external=false default (L45); the dotClass/summaryClass lookups (L46-47); the `inner` fragment with the rounded dot span (L51-54), the optional icon span (L55-59), the truncate flex-1 label span (L60-62), the text-xs summary span (L63-65), and the (to||onClick) ChevronRight (L66-68); the baseClasses cn() with flex/gap/min-h-[44px]/hover/focus (L72-76); the `to`+external <a target=_blank rel=noopener> branch (L78-91); the `to` internal <Link> branch (L92-96); the onClick <button> branch (L99-105); and the static <div> fallback (L107).

Source is web/browser-only (rule 4/7): react-router-dom Link, the <a>/<button>/<div> DOM elements, lucide-react ChevronRight (SVG), and the @/lib/cn Tailwind merger have no native parity surface. Per rule 7 a native-safe implementation was built with no DOM-only modules, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or web UI components imported — only react-native primitives plus the shared AppText and theme tokens.

Behavior/state/prop parity preserved: prop names (status, icon, label, summary, to, external, onClick) and the external=false default are unchanged; DOT_FOR_STATUS and TEXT_FOR_STATUS keep their names and five keys; the four render shapes and their precedence are reproduced exactly — `to`+external first, then `to` internal, then onClick, then the static fallback. dotClass/summaryClass are renamed dotColor/summaryColor since they now carry a color literal applied inline (dynamic per-status value) rather than a Tailwind class.

DOM -> RN primitives: react-router-dom <Link to> AND the external <a href target=_blank rel=noopener> both map to a Pressable accessibilityRole=link whose onPress calls Linking.openURL(to) (the InlineCallout seam). The web external/internal split is kept as a real if (external) branch so the `external` prop is honoured; on native the OS decides how a URL opens so both branches resolve through Linking (target=_blank/rel have no analog — documented). The <button onClick> -> Pressable accessibilityRole=button onPress=onClick; the static <div> -> accessible View accessibilityRole=text. Linking.openURL is wrapped in .catch(() => undefined) so an unregistered internal route never raises an unhandled rejection.

icon stays ReactNode-compatible: a renderIcon() helper (mirrors InlineCallout.renderNode) wraps raw string/number copy in styled AppText and passes caller-supplied native nodes through unchanged. The status dot <span> becomes a 10x10 (h-2.5 w-2.5) rounded View; the lucide ChevronRight (h-4 w-4) becomes a decorative '›' AppText glyph at fontSize 16. The dot, icon wrap, and chevron carry accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility=no-hide-descendants to mirror the web aria-hidden on those three elements.

Visual-intent mapping: the StatusHero green/amber/red/zinc/blue-400 dot + summary tints are kept as their exact Tailwind hex literals (#4ade80/#fbbf24/#f87171/#a1a1aa/#60a5fa) applied inline as dynamic per-status colors. CSS theme vars -> shared native tokens: --text-primary -> colors.textPrimary (label), --text-secondary -> colors.textSecondary (icon glyph), --text-muted -> colors.textMuted (chevron). Layout: flex w-full items-center gap-3 -> flexDirection row, width 100%, alignItems center, gap spacing.md (12); rounded-lg -> borderRadius 8; px-3 py-3 -> paddingHorizontal/paddingVertical spacing.md (12); min-h-[44px] -> minHeight 44 (tap target preserved). Text: text-sm font-medium -> fontSize 14 fontWeight 500 (label, flex 1 + minWidth 0 + numberOfLines 1 for truncate + textAlign left); text-xs -> fontSize 12 (summary, flexShrink 0).

cn/className + interactive states: React Native has no className, so the cn() base/hover/focus classes move to StyleSheet; the hover:bg-white/[0.04] maps to a Pressable pressed style (backgroundColor rgba(255,255,255,0.04)) and the focus-visible cyan ring has no native analog and collapses into that pressed feedback (web HealthRowProps has no className/style, so a native-only optional `style` override + `testID` are added for parity consumers and documented). The web aria-label `${label} — ${summary}` maps to accessibilityLabel on both link branches; the onClick button relies on its inner text like the web button.

Dependency note: web imports `type { HeroStatus } from './StatusHero'`, but the native StatusHero is not ported yet, so the HeroStatus union is defined and re-exported here to keep the file self-contained and type-safe; a future native StatusHero port can re-export from here or vice versa.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest).
